selection_process: Game skill, physical fitness & coach's observation during trial 40
Level Grade Pay Minimum Qualifying Marks
All eligible candidates are called for a Selection Trial. Only candidates securing 25 or more out of 40 marks for game skill
and coach's observations are declared FIT and assessed further by the Recruitment Committee. Candidates declared NOT FIT are not assessed further.
The offer of appointment is purely on merit. If two or more sportspersons score the same marks
preference is given to the younger candidate. No TA/DA/accommodation is provided for the trial; candidates must bring their own kit and four passport-size photographs

how_to_apply: Log on to the RRC/WR online application portal and fill in personal details/bio-data carefully.
Enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Card number (or 28-digit Aadhaar Enrolment ID if the card is not yet received).
Fill in educational qualification and sports achievement details, mentioning the specific position/event/discipline.
Upload the required scanned photograph (3.5cm x 3.5cm, JPG/JPEG, 100 DPI, 20-70 KB) without cap or sunglasses.
Upload the scanned signature (3.5cm x 2.5cm, JPG/JPEG, 100 DPI, 20-30 KB), not in block/capital or disjoined letters.
Pay the applicable application fee online through the integrated payment gateway.
Note the Registration Number generated on submission for future reference.
Take a printout of the application; it must be produced at the time of the Selection Trial.

content_sections.heading: Western Railway Sports Quota Selection Procedure
content_sections.text: All eligible candidates are called for a Selection Trial. Only candidates securing 25 or more out of 40 marks for game skill, physical fitness, and coach's observations are declared FIT and assessed further by the Recruitment Committee. Candidates declared NOT FIT are not assessed further. The offer of appointment is purely on merit. If two or more sportspersons score the same marks, preference is given to the younger candidate. No TA/DA/accommodation is provided for the trial; candidates must bring their own kit and four passport-size photographs, and may need to stay 2-3 days at their own arrangement.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Western Railway Sports Quota Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official website rrc-wr.com . Log on to the RRC/WR online application portal and fill in personal details/bio-data carefully. Enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Card number (or 28-digit Aadhaar Enrolment ID if the card is not yet received). Fill in educational qualification and sports achievement details, mentioning the specific position/event/discipline. Upload the required scanned photograph (3.5cm x 3.5cm, JPG/JPEG, 100 DPI, 20-70 KB) without cap or sunglasses. Upload the scanned signature (3.5cm x 2.5cm, JPG/JPEG, 100 DPI, 20-30 KB), not in block/capital or disjoined letters. Pay the applicable application fee online through the integrated payment gateway. Note the Registration Number generated on submission for future reference. Take a printout of the application; it must be produced at the time of the Selection Trial. Important: A separate application with separate fee is required for each discipline and for each pay level applied to. Multiple applications for a single discipline with differing particulars, or a single application for two or more events/games, will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Scanned copy of minimum academic qualification mark sheet/certificate (per applicable level) Certificate proving recognized sports achievement held between 01-04-2024 and the date of notification Certificate for proof of date of birth (SSC certificate or equivalent mark sheet) Caste certificate for SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates, where applicable OBC declaration (Annexure-E), where applicable Minority Community Declaration (Annexure-A), where applicable Income certificate for EBC fee exemption (Annexure-B), where applicable Aadhaar Card or Aadhaar Enrolment slip (original, at the time of trial)

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Name, father's name, and date of birth must exactly match across educational and sports certificates; any name change must be supported by a Gazette Notification or equivalent legal document, predating the online application. Candidates must keep their mobile number and e-mail ID active throughout the recruitment process; all official communication via SMS/e-mail/website is deemed read. Original documents (date of birth, educational qualification, sports achievement) must be produced on the day of trial; certificates in languages other than English/Hindi require an attested translation. Selected candidates may be posted anywhere on Western Railway and are liable for transfer to another Railway/establishment as per exigencies of service. Selected male candidates finally appointed are liable for active service in the Railway Engineers Unit of the Territorial Army. Selected candidates must submit a Service Bond of 5 years at the time of appointment. Appointment is subject to passing the requisite Medical Fitness Test, and final verification of educational/community certificates and antecedents. Candidates already employed in a PSU/Government Organization must produce a No Objection Certificate at the time of trial. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate; the decision of the Selection Committee/Railway Administration is final and binding. RRC/WR has not appointed any agent or coaching centre on its behalf; candidates should beware of touts and fraudulent job offers.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are available under Western Railway Sports Quota 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 64 posts - 21 in Level 5/4 & 3/2 (Group 'C') and 43 in Level 1 (erstwhile Group 'D') - are notified under Employment Notice No. RRC/WR/01/2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Online applications close on 30 September 2026 at 18:00 Hrs.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Minimum 18 years, maximum 25 years as on 01-01-2027 (born between 01-01-2002 and 01-01-2009).

faq.question: Q4. Is there reservation for SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD in this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no reservation for SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD & Ex-Servicemen in this Sports Quota drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: ₹500 (₹400 refundable) for general candidates; ₹250 (fully refundable) for SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen/PwD/Women/Minorities/EBC candidates, refundable to those found eligible who appear in the trial.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: A Selection Trial assessing game skill, physical fitness, and coach's observation (40 marks), sports achievements (50 marks), and educational qualification (10 marks), with level-wise minimum qualifying marks of 60-70 out of 100.

faq.question: Q7. Can I apply for more than one discipline or pay level?
faq.answer: Yes, but a separate application with separate fee is required for each discipline and each pay level.
